# `edit.paste`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/edit.paste.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`edit.paste`: pastes a project fragment onto `page` with its anchor at `at` (doc 06 §3.6, FR-DEV-029,
FR-UI-036, FR-UI-040), in one transaction (one undo step removes the records and the embedded copies).

**Rejected**, at the JSON Pointer named: `/page` a missing page, a generated page or a page type that takes no
symbols; `/fragment/format` another project format; `/fragment/grid` a page connection grid other than the
fragment's; `/at` a point that is not a grid point of the page; `/fragment/anchor` an anchor off the grid;
`/fragment/records` none or more than 10,000; `/fragment/records/<i>` a record that does not read, of a kind
outside device, function, representation, connection, junction and potential definition, of another schema
version, listed twice, a representation off the grid or of a representation type the page does not take, or a
mandatory reference that resolves to nothing; `/fragment/copies/<i>` a copy that `library.embed` refuses, listed
twice, or one the project holds in another version; `/fragment/nodes/<i>` a node listed twice or without a path.

**Effects.** (1) A library copy the project holds with the same `sha256` is reused, any other is embedded. (2)
Each structure node rebinds to the project's node of the same aspect and path, else to the one node of that
aspect whose aliases hold the leaf code; an unmatched node clears the slots naming it (the record inherits),
with a notice; no node is created. (3) Every record gets a minted ID, in (kind rank, fragment order); the
references are found from `ew_model::LINKS`: one to a fragment record takes its new ID, one to a library copy
stays (effect 1), a structure slot takes the rebound node, a page reference the target page, a function's
`kind.ip.external` stays only in its own project. (4) A reference that resolves to nothing is cleared when it
can be: a `Cascade` link never can; otherwise the member holding it, or the optional object directly around it
(never a member of the record itself other than the reference), is removed when the record still reads
without it, with a notice; else the paste is refused. A child device whose parent is cleared also loses its
`position`, and a `child` tag scheme. (5) Translation in grid steps: `Δk = index(at) − index(anchor)` per
axis; a grid coordinate becomes the grid point at its index plus `Δk`, any other moves by
`round_half_away(Δk × num / den)`; routes follow their ends as `rep.move`'s `steps` move them. (6) Tag
counters and frozen tags are cleared, wire numbers become unassigned, so the normalisers number the copies.

Cost: `Bulk` above 500 records. Outcome: the first pasted representation; the notices name every cleared
reference and unmatched structure node.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2) | yes |  | The new position of the fragment's anchor, a grid point of the page. |
| `fragment` | [`Fragment`](#fragment) | yes |  | The fragment. |
| `page` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The target page. |

## Types

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Fragment

A project fragment as one JSON object (spec §8.1): the `$fragment` header's known members, the records,
the library copies and the structure nodes. The ghost rectangles of the text form are not part of it.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2) | yes |  | The anchor: the minimum corner of the copied representations' bodies, snapped down to the grid. |
| `copies` | array of any JSON value | no | `[]` | The library copies the records name, in the `lib/` JSON form `library.embed` takes. |
| `format` | string | yes |  | The project format of the records (`0.1`). |
| `grid` | array of integer (format `uint64`, min 0) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) | yes |  | The source page's connection grid `[num, den]` in nanometres. |
| `nodes` | array of [`FragmentNode`](#fragmentnode) | no | `[]` | The structure nodes the records name. |
| `page_kind` | string | yes |  | The source page's type (`multi_line`). |
| `project` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The source project's ID. |
| `records` | array of any JSON value | yes |  | The records, canonical record objects (`$k` first), in fragment order. |

### FragmentNode

One structure node a fragment's records name (spec §8.1 item 5): its source ID, aspect, the codes of its
path from the root down and its aliases.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aliases` | array of string | no | `[]` | The node's aliases. |
| `aspect` | string | yes |  | The aspect (`location`, `function`, …), as the node record writes it. |
| `id` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The node's ID in the source project. |
| `path` | array of string | yes |  | The codes of the node's path, root first; the last is the node's own code. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
